label: Palembang
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Palembang, the historic Sumatran river city on the Musi River.
intro: Palembang's hotels in this directory sit in the heart of the city on and around the Musi River, near the landmark Ampera Bridge. One of Indonesia's oldest cities and the capital of South Sumatra, Palembang draws business travelers and visitors exploring its river heritage, Kemaro Island, and the wider South Sumatra region. The city is served by Sultan Mahmud Badaruddin II International Airport (PLM), a short drive from the main hotel district.
